author: Digital Foundry
description:
It's the Digital Foundry Supporter Program that makes the DF Retro Super Show possible! Support the team, support the show, get high quality, ad-free video downloads of all DF content: https://patreon.com/digitalfoundry

With ten episodes of the DF Retro Super Show under their belts - 11 if you want to include the Analogue 3D review - John, Coury and Marc hand over the topic selection duties to backers of the DF Supporter Program. After discussing the latest retro news, it's straight into tackling questions direct from the audience.

00:00 - Introduction
01:02 - News 1 - Popcorn and Spinner Kickstarter
06:49 - News 2 - Retrotap from Kytor Industries
14:10 - News 3 - Evercade Nexus
21:58 - News 4 - Tokyo Wave Rush
27:01 - MAIN TOPIC: Q1 - "What new games would you like to see a demake of?"
32:55 - Q2 - "Can new LCD tech make old light guns work?"
36:10 - Q3 - "Do you have any arcade hardware?"
47:52 - Q4 - "What would the 5th Gen of consoles have been like without Sony?"
